notice_seed_recharging: This seed is recharging. {seconds}s to go.
notice_need_pollen: Need {cost} pollen. Grow a Bloom or collect golden pollen.
notice_choose_row: Choose a row: faster attacks and +50% Bloom harvest. Move water every 6 seconds.
notice_choose_dig: Choose a planted cell to dig. Half the pollen is returned.
notice_row_resting: That row is resting. Plant on the open green rows.
notice_row_watered: Row {row} is watered: +35% fire rate, +50% harvest.
notice_cell_taken: A plant already lives here. Use the trowel to make room.
notice_seed_not_ready: This seed is not ready yet.
notice_husk_got_through: A husk got through! Protect row {row}
how_lead: Choose a seed, then an empty plot. Pollen buys plants.
how_touch: Tap a seed, then tap the lawn.
how_guide: Pollen Bloom banks pollen. Thornspitter and Twinthorn shoot down their lane, Barkshell soaks up bites, Rimecap chills, Blast Gourd clears a patch. Shamblers plod, Sprinters hop the first plant they meet, Scrapmask and Ironhelm wear armor, and the mossy Brute takes everything you've got. From garden 3, move the water between rows: faster shots and richer pollen, with a 6 second recharge.
trowel_blurb: Dig a plant up. Refunds half its pollen.
advice: Try more defenders in the lanes under pressure. Every seed counts.
notice_runner_hopped: A runner hopped your front plant!
